title: MCD valuation v8 frozen 14-scene layout contract
purpose: Deterministic logical-coordinate contract for Korean MCD Shorts. Financial text, captions, and geometry are composited outside generative video plates.

timeline.sample_policy: probe every scene boundary and every scene midpoint; clamp the final endpoint to the last decodable frame

market.mcd_6m_adj_return.definition: Six-month adjusted-close return used by the v8 visual brief.

market.qqq_6m_adj_return.definition: Six-month adjusted-close return used as the technology-growth comparison.

strategy.staged_buy_candidate.definition: Educational scenario, not individualized investment advice.

business.restaurant_count.definition: System restaurant count reported in McDonald's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q.

business.franchise_share_approx.definition: Approximate franchised share by restaurant count; not a margin or cash-flow ratio.

business.rent_model.definition: Franchise arrangements can combine rent, royalties, and related fees; this label is explanatory.

business.rent_h1_2026.definition: H1 2026 rent revenue line used in the visual example.

business.royalty_h1_2026.definition: H1 2026 royalty revenue line used in the visual example.

shareholder.dividend_ttm.definition: TTM dividend cash flow input in the v8 brief.

shareholder.net_buyback.definition: Net cash share repurchase input in the v8 brief.

shareholder.cash_return_rate_approx.definition: Approximate cash shareholder-return rate, not a GAAP margin or guaranteed yield.

shareholder.dividend_streak_years.definition: Annual dividend-increase streak described in the 2025 Form 10-K.

shareholder.cash_return_combined.definition: Dividend plus net buyback over the reference market-cap denominator.

dividend.ttm_yield.definition: TTM dividend divided by the reference close; not a forward-return forecast.

dividend.rank_2020_month_end.definition: Rank convention used by the v8 brief: second-highest observation from 2020 onward.

dividend.history_2015_peak.definition: Historical comparison point; not a claim that current yield is the all-time high.

dividend.history_2010_percentile.definition: Historical placement statistic from the v8 monthly-yield calculation.

risk.beta_mcd.definition: Sample beta estimated from five-year weekly adjusted-close returns.

risk.beta_spy.definition: Benchmark beta convention for the comparison rail.

risk.beta_qqq.definition: QQQ comparison beta estimated with the same weekly-return method.

risk.correlation_mcd_qqq.definition: Historical correlation; low co-movement does not mean inverse correlation.

risk.total_debt.definition: Approximate total-debt figure used for the risk visual.

risk.us_guest_counts.definition: Reported US comparable guest-count pressure; not a forecast.

strategy.entry_1.definition: Small first tranche in an educational staged-buy scenario.

strategy.entry_2.definition: Second scenario band, conditional on the stated assumptions.

strategy.cancel_rule.definition: Educational decision rule; not personalized advice.

mcd-golden-arches-contextual.rights_note: Use only as an accurate, unmodified contextual identifier; the layout contract does not grant trademark rights.

world-map-vector.rights_note: Record GeoJSON/SVG source, projection, data date, and asset license in the production license manifest.
